description: This file contains server-side C# code-behind logic for the 'SetExam' ASP.NET Web Forms page in an online examination system. It includes event handlers for page load, navigation buttons, course selection, question addition, and exam setup, managing interactions with the database to add questions and exams.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ASP.NET Web Forms page managing question setting and exam configuration within the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial load of the page, currently commented out.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears all input fields related to question and exam details.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a multiple-choice question into the database and updates question number.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates a new exam entry for the selected course in the database.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course dropdown based on semester selection.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number display based on selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.
